ex.en: We plan to hike up the mountain early tomorrow morning.
ex.zh: 我们打算明天清早上山徒步。

words.note: hike 作名词可指徒步，也可指价格上调，如 a price hike。

ex.en: The museum displays pottery from an ancient civilization in the region.
ex.zh: 博物馆展出了该地区一个古代文明的陶器。

words.note: ancient 多作定语，修饰历史久远的事物。

ex.en: The team was sent on a mission to rescue the trapped climbers.
ex.zh: 这支队伍被派去执行营救被困登山者的任务。

words.note: mission 指使命、任务；on a mission 表正在执行任务。

ex.en: Reading aloud helps children develop their cognitive skills.
ex.zh: 朗读有助于儿童发展认知能力。

words.note: 来自拉丁语 cognoscere（认识），常修饰 skills、process。

ex.en: The council adopted a new policy on waste sorting last month.
ex.zh: 议会上个月通过了一项垃圾分类新政策。

words.note: adopt 是采用、收养；adapt 是适应、改编，勿混。

ex.en: My passport will expire next March, so I need to renew it.
ex.zh: 我的护照明年三月到期，所以我需要续办。

words.note: 指期限终止，多用于证件、合同、会员资格。

ex.en: Customs officers found two men trying to smuggle watches into the country.
ex.zh: 海关人员发现两名男子正试图把手表走私入境。

words.note: 常接 into／out of；smuggler 指走私者。

ex.en: We had to hustle to catch the last bus home.
ex.zh: 我们不得不赶紧去赶最后一班回家的公交车。

words.note: 名词常用 the hustle and bustle，指城市的忙碌喧嚣。

ex.en: Many residents oppose the plan to build a factory near the river.
ex.zh: 许多居民反对在河边建工厂的计划。

words.note: be opposed to 中 to 是介词，后接名词或 doing。

ex.en: This small device can measure the temperature of your coffee.
ex.zh: 这个小装置能测量咖啡的温度。

words.note: 指器械、装置；device 与 devise（设计）形近易混。

ex.en: He provided live commentary on the match for a local radio station.
ex.zh: 他为当地一家电台解说了这场比赛的实况。

words.note: 指实况解说或评论；comment 是较短的意见。

ex.en: The workers decided to sue the company for unfair dismissal.
ex.zh: 工人们决定以不当解雇为由起诉该公司。

words.note: sue sb for sth 是常用结构，后可接 damages。

ex.en: Even by a conservative estimate, the repairs will cost a fortune.
ex.zh: 即便按保守估计，维修也要花一大笔钱。

words.note: conservative estimate 指偏低的估计；反义词 liberal。

ex.en: The baby lay on its belly and watched the toy roll away.
ex.zh: 婴儿俯卧着，看着玩具滚到一边。

words.note: belly 比 stomach 口语化；on one's belly 指俯卧。

ex.en: Students have free access to the online library all year round.
ex.zh: 学生全年可免费使用在线图书馆。

words.note: access to 中 to 为介词；accessible 是形容词。

ex.en: She will attend an international conference on climate change in June.
ex.zh: 她将于六月参加一个关于气候变化的国际会议。

words.note: conference 指正式会议；press conference 是记者招待会。

ex.en: These primitive tools were made of stone and animal bone.
ex.zh: 这些原始工具由石头和兽骨制成。

words.note: 指原始的、简陋的；prim 词根含「最初」之义。

ex.en: She turned the knob slowly and pushed the door open.
ex.zh: 她慢慢转动门把手，把门推开了。

words.note: 指球形把手或旋钮；词首 k 不发音。

ex.en: It is advisable to book your ticket well before the holiday.
ex.zh: 最好在假期前提前订好票。

words.note: advisable 常用 It is advisable to do 句型。

ex.en: She worked hard to overcome her fear of speaking in public.
ex.zh: 她努力克服在公开场合讲话的恐惧。

words.note: overcome 过去式为 overcame，过去分词为 overcome。

ex.en: They spent the weekend in a small log cabin by the lake.
ex.zh: 他们在湖边一间小木屋里度过了周末。

words.note: 指小木屋，也指船舱、机舱；cabin crew 指乘务员。

ex.en: Each student had to recite a short poem from memory.
ex.zh: 每个学生都必须凭记忆背诵一首短诗。

words.note: 强调背诵或朗诵；re-（再）+ cit（引用）。

ex.en: The new laws were used to oppress anyone who spoke out.
ex.zh: 新法律被用来压迫任何敢出声的人。

words.note: oppress 指压迫或使心情沉重；oppression 是名词。

ex.en: He reads the news every morning to keep up with current affairs.
ex.zh: 他每天早上看新闻以了解时事。

words.note: 作形容词是当前的；作名词指水流、电流、潮流。

ex.en: Her new shoes hurt because the heels were too high.
ex.zh: 她的新鞋磨脚，因为鞋跟太高了。

words.note: 指脚后跟、鞋跟；Achilles' heel 喻致命弱点。

ex.en: The news of the layoffs cast a gloom over the office.
ex.zh: 裁员的消息给办公室蒙上了一层阴影。

words.note: gloomy 是形容词；cast a gloom over 指蒙上阴影。

ex.en: She adores walking along the beach at sunset.
ex.zh: 她非常喜欢在日落时沿着海滩散步。

words.note: adore 语气强于 like，后接 doing，也可指敬慕。

ex.en: If the pain persists, you should see a doctor at once.
ex.zh: 如果疼痛持续，你应当立刻去看医生。

words.note: persist in doing sth 指坚持；也可指持续存在。

ex.en: Drivers were told to proceed with caution on the icy road.
ex.zh: 司机被告知在结冰的路面上要小心行驶。

words.note: with caution 表谨慎地；caution 作动词接 against。

ex.en: His offensive remarks upset several people at the dinner table.
ex.zh: 他在餐桌上的无礼言论让好几个人不快。

words.note: 出自 offend；take the offensive 指转为攻势。
